57-page slide report. Locators are printed page numbers followed by (PDF p.N) because the printed numbering restarts per section (LCOE appendix pages are printed 36-40 on PDF 46-50, CCS pages 31-32 on PDF 39-40, LCOH key assumptions 44-45 on PDF 56-57). Heat-relevant rows only: geothermal, gas peaking, new-build nuclear (large LWR), gas combined cycle, gas CC + CCS (new build combined system and retrofit CCS only), and the Green and Pink hydrogen PEM/alkaline electrolyzer cases (LCOH v3.0). Skipped: solar PV, wind, coal (new build, its high case includes 90% CCS but only as a footnote), operating-plant marginal costs, battery LCOS, residential/C&I. Every number is a low-case to high-case range with no central value, so value is blank. OVERLAP: geothermal, gas peaking, nuclear, gas CC and the four electrolyzer cases are repeated, with updated values, in Lazard 2024 (lazard_2024_001); the 2024 edition supersedes them. Traps: (1) price year not stated, 2023 used; (2) heat rate row is blank for gas peaking in 2023; (3) "Capacity 100 - 20 MW" means the low case is the 100 MW plant and the high case the 20 MW plant, so capex ranges mix scale and case; (4) nuclear and geothermal LCOE are v15.0/v14.0 results adjusted for inflation (limited data); (5) subsidized LCOH and LCOE include U.S. IRA credits; (6) CCS-only retrofit capex $/kW is per kW of the host 550 MW plant.
